brand.splashSub: The endcap where every product opens the game.

product.label: Activated Cap
product.description: Six-panel cap with a woven NFC label under the brim. One tap opens the experience: no app, no login wall.

unlock.title: Matching avatar cap
unlock.sub: Digital accessory · one claim per cap

product.label: Collector Plush
product.description: A plush of the property's hero character with an NFC chip in the tush tag. The physical friend unlocks its digital twin.
product.trigger: NFC chip in the tush tag

product.label: Activated Keychain
product.description: Acrylic charm with an embedded NFC chip. The lowest-price way into the game, carried every day.

product.label: Activated Desk Mat
product.description: XL desk mat printed with the key art. The QR is part of the artwork, so the print itself is the trigger.

product.label: Boxed Collectible
product.description: Window-box collectible with a QR inside the box. Scanning it reveals which skin came in this box.

unlock.title: Skin reveal
unlock.sub: Matched to the figure in the box

product.label: Activated Tee
product.description: Heavyweight tee with an NFC care label. Wear it, tap it, and the same tee lands on your avatar.

product.label: Activated Hoodie
product.description: Midweight pullover with an NFC label at the hem. Owning it unlocks the matching hoodie for your avatar.

tour.title: Stop them in the aisle
tour.body: A 3.84 m endcap built from modular lightbox towers, a channel-letter header and a 12-tile video wall. Every surface either sells or activates.

tour.title: Every product unlocks the game
tour.body: Each product carries an NFC tag or a QR. Tap one on the shelf and it comes off the shelf in 3D.

tour.title: Tap, play, unlock
tour.body: A tap opens the experience in the browser. No app: a short drop, a reveal, then a reward in the game.

tour.title: Measured
tour.body: Activations, repeat visits and returns to the game, reported by store and product.
